blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: *Abhinavagupta is informed that his nondual philosophy has made phonetics impossible. He responds by introducing a pot, happiness, knowledge, the Self, rocks, trees, humans, gods, string instruments, drums, crows, lions and camels. Then he summons Patañjali, argues that even indistinct sounds participate in Mātṛkā, and discovers that the sacred alphabet can contain sixty-four letters without requiring sixty-four independent Absolutes.*

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: This is the insight I want to retain from Part XVII.
blocks.directed: This is the insight I want to retain from Part XVII.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta has established that the divine power of expression is not restricted to one physical configuration.
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta has established that the divine power of expression is not restricted to one physical configuration.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: It can become manifest through human speech.
blocks.directed: It can become manifest through human speech.

blocks.text: And through the subtle *Nāda* described by the Tantric scriptures.
blocks.directed: And through the subtle *Nāda* described by the Tantric scriptures.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: Now we must distinguish the levels.
blocks.directed: Now we must distinguish the levels.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: The conventional phonology of Sanskrit remains meaningful.
blocks.directed: The conventional phonology of Sanskrit remains meaningful.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: A crow's call is not a grammatically correct Sanskrit sentence merely because both involve sound.
blocks.directed: A crow's call is not a grammatically correct Sanskrit sentence merely because both involve sound.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: A musical note does not possess the same semantic structure as the word *ghaṭa*, pot.
blocks.directed: A musical note does not possess the same semantic structure as the word *ghaṭa*, pot.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: And the metaphysical classification of subtle sound is not identical with a modern scientific account of acoustics.
blocks.directed: And the metaphysical classification of subtle sound is not identical with a modern scientific account of acoustics.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: But none of those differences requires the sounds to exist independently of the universal expressive power.
blocks.directed: But none of those differences requires the sounds to exist independently of the universal expressive power.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: And that is the philosophical point.
blocks.directed: And that is the philosophical point.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: **The same consciousness can manifest genuinely different sounds without becoming fundamentally divided by those differences.**
blocks.directed: **The same consciousness can manifest genuinely different sounds without becoming fundamentally divided by those differences.**

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: This is why the entire passage returns to Mātṛkā.
blocks.directed: This is why the entire passage returns to Mātṛkā.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: The Mother is not merely fifty written glyphs.
blocks.directed: The Mother is not merely fifty written glyphs.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: Within the Tantric system, she is the conscious power underlying the manifestation of sound.
blocks.directed: Within the Tantric system, she is the conscious power underlying the manifestation of sound.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: And her differentiated expressions can be classified in various ways.
blocks.directed: And her differentiated expressions can be classified in various ways.

blocks.text: But the multiplication of sound-classes doesn't multiply the ultimate conscious ground.
blocks.directed: But the multiplication of sound-classes doesn't multiply the ultimate conscious ground.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: Now the really beautiful thing is what happens next.
blocks.directed: Now the really beautiful thing is what happens next.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: Having established the universality of Mātṛkā, Abhinavagupta refuses to become trapped in endlessly enumerating her variations.
blocks.directed: Having established the universality of Mātṛkā, Abhinavagupta refuses to become trapped in endlessly enumerating her variations.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: Because the essential point is **pūrṇatā**, fullness.
blocks.directed: Because the essential point is **pūrṇatā**, fullness.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: And he turns to the deeper question.
blocks.directed: And he turns to the deeper question.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: What is the relation between the word *go*, cow, and the actual object?
blocks.directed: What is the relation between the word *go*, cow, and the actual object?

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: Why can a child acquire a word through convention?
blocks.directed: Why can a child acquire a word through convention?

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: And how can convention itself be established unless consciousness already possesses a more fundamental capacity for meaningful apprehension?
blocks.directed: And how can convention itself be established unless consciousness already possesses a more fundamental capacity for meaningful apprehension?

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: That is where Part XVIII begins.
blocks.directed: That is where Part XVIII begins.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: Now language itself is going on trial.
blocks.directed: Now language itself is going on trial.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: And Abhinavagupta is going to prosecute the idea that words acquire meaning from an entirely self-sufficient external convention.
blocks.directed: And Abhinavagupta is going to prosecute the idea that words acquire meaning from an entirely self-sufficient external convention.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - Śiva doesn't speak only Sanskrit
blocks.text: The poor grammarians haven't a chance.
